buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (a) The product offered by the bidder should have service centre at Tinsukia/Dibrugarh area. (b) OEM BIS registration is compulsory. (c) Bidder to submit BoQ compliance and accept offered product specification. (d) Bidder to extend the warranty offered by the OEM on the product to the buyer. (e) The Bidders to submit an affidavit that only brand new Gen Set including lead acid battery & acces sories if any will be supplied if in case the supply order is awarded to the bidder. (f) The Bidder to submit an affidavit that for any defect in the Gen Set within the warranty period will b e attended by the Bidder within 24 Hrs of receipt of intimationfrom consignee and machine will be repaired under warranty within 3 days of intimation. Non compliance of this clause by the Bidder will render the firm disqualified from any future Bids of in the AOR of (P) Udayak for two years from the incident intimation dat e. (g) Bidder to submit an affidavit that they will supply only the product for which the Firm is holding OEM Authorization certificate and have submitted the same with the technical Bid. Failure to supply the authoriz ed product will render the firm disqualified for any of the future bids under the AOR project Udayak for 2 ye ars. (h) The successful bidder will be required to commission the Gen Set at the consignee locations withou t any extra cost above the Bid value. (j) The required specifications for the 5 KVA Gen Set and 2.2 KVA Gen Set are enclosed as Appx ‘A’ and bidder to submit an undertaking to supply the Gen Set as per the required specification mentioned. (k) Previous experience of supply of 5 KVA Diesel Generator of the bidder will only be considered in past performance experience criteria. .
